method: TP2-MV-ALiBi transformer, final (val-loss checkpoint + warm-up + causal p>=0.5 selection)
selection_rule: fixed p>=0.5, zero tuning, fully causal
notes: Selection rule is a fixed constant (p>=0.5) compared per-trade against that trade's own calibrated probability -- no validation-year tuning, no reference to any other trade's prediction, no quantile computed over any period. Fully causal and live-deployable as-is.
Training protocol (LR=3e-5, warm-up, grad clip 1.0, checkpoint on val_loss) is unchanged from v3.
This script writes only *_v3final_* outputs; no v2/v3/v4 artifact is modified.
